1.title: Ex-Olympian pleads not guilty to Reflecting Pool vandalism charges
1.summary: A former US Olympian canoeist denies accusations that he deliberately damaged the lining of the refurbished Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

2.title: Former Olympian Pleads Not Guilty to Damaging Reflecting Pool
2.summary: David Hearn is one of at least four people accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool that has been plagued with challenges.

3.title: Justin Baldoni describes painful saga as he breaks silence on Blake Lively dispute
3.summary: Justin Baldoni and his wife spoke for the first time in nearly two years about his contentious legal battle with Blake Lively.

5.title: Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Sink Into Violent Cycle After Latest Strikes
5.summary: Attacks on ships were followed by new U.S. strikes on Iran, which responded by firing at Gulf nations. The pattern of hostilities has all but collapsed a cease-fire, with little sign that either side will step back.

6.title: Poland Sentences Russian Exile to 7 Years in Prison for Spying
6.summary: Igor Rogov, who has publicly opposed the Kremlin, was arrested in 2024 and later confessed to spying for Russian intelligence on regime opponents living abroad.
